_about: A persona is who is 'speaking' in a description. The LLM that writes the descriptions must
use a different persona and project type for each one of a profile, so the same
requirements appear in different words (a founder says 'brand assets', a hobbyist says 'my
character names'). This tests that the system understands meaning, not keywords. Personas
are free text chosen by the writing model (qwen3.8-27b), not a fixed list.
some_other_personas: A freelance web developer creating a modular project management suite.
A startup founder launching a B2B analytics platform.
A university researcher releasing a collaborative scientific simulation engine.
Bootstrapped startup founder building a B2B SaaS
Data Science Team Lead at a Consulting Firm
Data Scientist at a mid-sized fintech
